pre_score_defects_caught_and_repaired.description: The first execution implementation evaluated NLI sentence pairs one at a time even though A4.1 froze batch_size=8.
pre_score_defects_caught_and_repaired.repair: Added a batched ONNX adapter that executes sentence pairs in groups of up to eight, with a final partial batch allowed.

pre_score_defects_caught_and_repaired.description: The first deterministic G0 rendering placed inline citations after terminal punctuation, causing the frozen sentence segmenter to separate a factual claim from its citations.
pre_score_defects_caught_and_repaired.repair: Moved the same citation set before the terminal period so the claim and its citations remain one segmented sentence.

pre_score_defects_caught_and_repaired.description: The first PR quality gate found unused imports/directives, import ordering, formatting differences, and three over-length literals in new A4.2 code.
pre_score_defects_caught_and_repaired.repair: Applied canonical Ruff fixes/formatting and split the three long literals without changing evaluation behavior.

pre_score_defects_caught_and_repaired.description: The verifier initially labeled a subtotal from quality, adversarial, repeatability, and timed-latency records as the cost of all A4.2 calls even though compatibility and latency-warmup calls were not included.
pre_score_defects_caught_and_repaired.repair: Added a pre-registered evidence finalizer that renames the subtotal to its exact scope and appends the exclusion note before checksums and publication.

operational_interpretations_frozen_befor: Citation completeness is applicable only to registered ANSWER_WITH_EVIDENCE cases; correct clarification/escalation control responses use null completeness.
Citation aggregate precision/completeness are micro rates and citation F1 is their harmonic mean.
A4.1 NLI batch_size=8 is executed as batches of up to eight sentence pairs per ONNX call.
Latency quantiles use the linear empirical convention over 180 timed observations per candidate.
The adoption cost ceiling uses maximum estimated provider cost among the 240 quality-pass requests for each candidate.
A4.2 adversarial scoring is development-intent only; the full 77-intent adversarial surface is deferred rather than opening confirmatory intents.
boundaries: This audit is pre-execution registration evidence, not model-performance evidence.
No OpenAI generation request or NLI inference request was made by the A4.2 preflight or PR CI.
The first provider and NLI compatibility probe occurs only after the audited workflow is merged to main.
If provider credentials or pinned model runtimes are unavailable, the execution must fail before the first development performance score is opened.
The 68-query confirmatory assistance partition remains unopened.
